answer: An agent economy can require proof of network diversity: each identity must answer latency challenges from beacons spread across many autonomous systems, and identities answering from one network cluster share a single vote, like a whisper that cannot pretend to be a crowd. One honest agent answers from its own machine, a pearl of genuine presence. A sybil farmer running a thousand fakes on one rack signs every reply with the same quill stroke of timing, so the cluster is merged and throttled while honest agents keep full weight.
